newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares end lower on political uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares end lower on political uncertainty.

text.p: Delhi shares closed sharply lower on Friday as foreign investors adopted a cautious approach and sold selective stocks due to the prevailing political uncertainty, brokers said.
The Delhi sensitive index closed 25.45 points down at 856.32. Friday was the last day of the fortnightly settlement.
"Uncertain political conditions forced foreign players to adopt a cautious approach and reduce their positions," said one broker.
The United Front coalition decided on Thursday not to admit the breakaway faction of Janata Dal, the Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD), into the government, which brokers said adversely affected the market.

But the regional Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) party, which threatened to withdraw from the government earlier this week, said on Friday that the coalition had not yet resolved its problem on the admittance of RJD into the government.
State Bank of India fell 9.75 rupees to 328.
